name: dsh-professor-brand
description: This host's own mark and wordmark in the harness sidebar and conversation hero, in place of the shipped DeepSeek brand.

comments.client: `lib/client.js` is HAND-WRITTEN in the module loader's registration form rather than produced by a bundler, for the reason dsh-professor-pane's package.json gives at greater length: every shipped client half in node_modules/@deepseek-ai is that same shape, so the format is the loader's contract. This one is a hundred-odd lines of React.createElement and needs a build step even less than the pane does.
comments.inject: `dsh.client.inject` names PACKAGES whose client halves must be live first, not services. ui-sidebar declares `sidebar.brand.mark` and `sidebar.brand.name`; ui-conversation declares `conversation.hero.brand.mark`; client-runtime provides `slots`. The nested `slots.inject` in client.js means the order is not actually load-critical — the registrations wait for each declaration and withdraw with it — but naming them is what makes that robustness explicit rather than accidental.
comments.official: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official stays mounted. All three slots are `kind: single`, which shadows rather than stacks and renders the LOWEST priority, so registering at -1 displaces the shipped brand without unmounting anything. Disabling its row instead would not work alone: ui-sidebar renders each brand slot with `fallback: FishLogo`, so an empty slot shows the shipped whale.
